script: He threatened to punch me over a burger discount—this shocked everyone.. He walked in, eyes on the burger sign, no card in hand. I scanned it—full price. I said, "Bruh, you got to follow the app steps and swipe your loyalty card to get the discount." He didn't even look up. I checked the system. He hadn't swiped our card in three years. He was a one‑off, a promo‑hunter. I explained, "Sorry, you're not eligible." He started yelling, "You're not my boss, you're a joke!" Then he raised a fist and said, "I'll punch your teeth out." (Like, seriously? The audacity.) I stayed calm. "I am just doing my job." He called the manager, claimed I was bad at customer service, said I should be fired. The couple behind us heard it, nodded, "I know, right?" The tension built—he was ready to throw a punch, I was ready to stay professional. I kept my voice low, my hands out of reach. I didn't even flinch. In the end, the manager stepped in, told him to leave, and I kept serving the rest of the line. I am better at this than anyone else here, and that's how it went down.
